# a comment <# multi-line comment #> param( [string]$Name = "world" ) function Get-Greeting { param([string]$Who) return "Hello, $Who" } $msg = Get-Greeting -Who $Name Write-Output $msg if ($msg -like "Hello*") { Write-Host "matched" -ForegroundColor Green } $list = @(1, 2, 3) foreach ($i in $list) { Write-Output $i }
